title: Cartesian abelian sheaves and cartesian modules form weak Serre subcategories closed under colimits
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Closure lemma (statement 2668-2685, proof 2687-2710): cartesian abelian sheaves (resp. O-modules under flat face maps) form a weak Serre subcategory and are closed under colimits - kernels and cokernels by exactness of the simplicial functors, extensions by the 5-lemma, colimits because pullback is a left adjoint; the modules case reuses the same argument with exactness of flat pullback and the reduction to the face maps; no verification is omitted. H2: category-level closure argument.
